September 11, 2026 Agencies seek comment on proposed third-party risk management guidance and issue statement on community bank engagement with core service providers Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation National Credit Union Administration Office of the Comptroller of the Currency For release at 10:00 a.m. EDT Share --> --> --> --> --> --> Today the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation, the Federal Reserve Board, the National Credit Union Administration, and the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (collectively, the agencies) requested comment on proposed guidance to assist financial institutions with managing risks associated with third-party relationships. The proposed guidance reflects the agencies' supervisory experience and lessons learned from examining financial institutions' third-party risk management practices. reason: Third-party risk guidance creates arguable debate: does prescriptive regulation improve resilience or impose compliance costs that weaken smaller institutions?
angle: Regulators should avoid one-size-fits-all third-party risk rules that burden community banks without proportional safety gains.
